notes: Tax code structure only. effective_from 2026-01-01 is the date this pack's data starts, not the date any law took effect. A rate of null means no figure has been confirmed from an official source; it is never guessed. Rates are percentages (12.5 = 12.5 %). A rate with status 'researched' comes from public research (docs/country-packs-research-2026-10.md): it is used, with its confidence, research date and sources, and what it taxes says so until the owner confirms it through a pack release (ADM-04). Owner decision 2026-10-22: low-confidence research is entered too, shown as 'Researched, low confidence: not externally reviewed'.
todo: Fuel (Fuel station module): which excise duty, road maintenance levy and other charges apply to petrol, diesel, kerosene and LPG, whether they are itemised on the receipt or part of the pump price, and the regulator's maximum retail prices. A specific amount per litre is not a percentage tax code, so none is built in; the fuel item's tax category carries only the VAT code.

Tourism and catering levies (Hotel module): whether they apply to room and food charges, their rates, base and legal reference, and whether they are tax codes of this pack. Hotel applies only the tax codes a company lists in its settings; no rate is built in.
VAT_STD: confirm the researched 16% standard rate (VAT Act) with its legal reference; it is used now, marked researched.
VAT_ZERO: confirm the researched 0% zero rate (VAT Act Second Schedule) and its official name.

VAT_WHT: 2% of the taxable value, withheld by agents the Commissioner appoints (Tax Procedures Act s. 42A; rate from the Finance Act 2019; KRA overview of December 2024). Medium: no later change was found, but the Finance Act 2026 was not checked. Confirm, with who withholds it.
Excise duty: which excise codes apply to the products sold, their rates or specific amounts, with legal references.
fiscal_code: the KRA eTIMS tax band for each code (needed for the eTIMS integration, phase 4).
VAT_EXEMPT: confirm the official name and that it maps to the eTIMS band.
